To get the best results with your new mattress, here are a few simple tips for a perfect setup:

Unpacking
Your mattress will arrive compressed and rolled in a box. It is important to unpack it within 30 days of delivery. Once opened, it will regain its full shape in just 2 to 3 hours, and you can sleep on it the very same night.

Bed Base Compatibility
The Hybrid Mattress works perfectly with most bed bases, including fixed or flexible slats, upholstered bases, and storage beds. However, please note that it is not recommended for use with electric bed bases.

Maintenance
